notes:
Lead: Maya Chen (AE) — product-led SaaS analytics platform. Mid-market, heavy personalization + search for enterprise customers. Currently using another major LLM API provider for chat/support and embeddings; evaluating migration to Redwood Hosted with plan to move to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation.

Summary of requirements:
- Workloads: customer support chat (context windows up to ~12k tokens), semantic search over product docs (embeddings + reranking), realtime personalization snippets.
- Latency targets: p95 < 450ms for short chat prompts (<=512 tokens), p95 < 800ms for long context flows.
- Throughput: steady-state ~30-50 rps across peak shards, occasional burst to 120 rps during releases.
- Cost sensitivity: target 20-35% decrease in per-token operational cost vs current vendor after Dedicated optimization.
- Model prefs: prefer flushed open models and Redwood-verified variants; require function-calling parity with existing provider.
- Migration blockers: prompt parity/regression risk is primary — internal eval suite shows ~6% drop in semantic accuracy on reranking tests after moving to Redwood-hosted test model; need regression debugging and prompt/response tuning.
- Security/compliance: require SSO (SAML), org-level audit logs, KMS integration for keys at Dedicated, and option for EU data residency for some customers.

Recent quotes from the team:
- "We can tolerate some perf tweaks but regressions on reranking will cost us", product lead.
- "Need a clear rollback story and compatibility shim for our SDK", eng manager.

POC plan: 2-week hosted POC (Feb 18 - Mar 03) used to validate compatibility layer + prompt parity. Test harness: ~150 canonical prompts, 2k sampled user sessions, synthetic burst tests to 150 rps. Metrics: semantic accuracy, rerank MAP@5, latency p95/p99, token cost.

POC outcomes so far: Hosted POC completed; functional parity mostly OK; two areas flagged: reranking delta (~6% MAP drop) and function-calling edge-case differences (JSON schema mismatches). Rafael (SE) triaged; created RI-5231 for kernel/decoding tweak and RI-5287 for function-calling adapter.

Pricing conversation: interested in Reserved Dedicated with 12-month commit. Asking for blended committed rate that accounts for caching and batching optimizations. Finance wants a three-tier proposal: small dedicated pool (baseline), burst credits, and a performance SLA credit.

Operations notes: want canary rollout path (Hosted -> Dedicated canary -> Dedicated full), plan to use Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching, quant profiles). They asked for sample rollout config and rollback policy.

Next actions (short):
- Rafael to deliver canary config and regression remediation plan by 2026-03-12.
- Legal to circulate MSA and Dedicated SLA draft (AE to nudge legal) by 2026-03-20.
- Run Dedicated trial (2 weeks) with same eval harness; compare cost and p95.

Staging/Artifacts: drive links above, test harness repo stub available on internal GH (bridgecrest/repro-eval — access requested).
